Thanks for the heads-up. Procurement can accommodate invoice-only onboarding for low-risk, low-dollar pilots, but we need to validate a few items first. Based on our temporary-invoice policy, please collect: 

- Signed SOW (we need an executed pdf)
- Completed W-9 and tax/legal vendor name match
- Proof of bank account (remittance) or vendor billing contact
- Vendor risk questionnaire (basic)

Operational limits we typically impose:
- Max aggregate spend on temporary lane: $20,000
- Max duration: 90 days
- Finance holdback: require payment within 30 days of invoice; but we flag for accelerated review if spend approaches cap

If EdgeLens meets the above and there are no red flags in the vendor questionnaire, we can approve a temporary invoice-only lane. I'm attaching the procurement-evidence-checklist.xlsx to this thread.

One more ask: please confirm the billing entity on the W-9 matches the SOW and the contractor account in HubSpot (deal D-83421).

-David

Thanks for the details. Finance will approve a temporary invoice-only exception for EdgeLens with the following conditions:
